```{r setup}
library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggtext)
library(DT)
library(yardstick)
library(caret)
library(tigerstats)
```

## Importing all raw data sets

```{r,output=F}
files <-list.files(path="../plots/data",full.names=T)
df <- files |> map_dfr(read_csv) 
# looking at the target plots only. and calculating means and variances of each 
#target plot
```

We now calculate the mean shift and the standard deviation of each target plot.

```{r}
target <- df |> 
  filter(panel=="target") |> 
  rename(lineup_id=picid)

#pic_details to include the change point in calculating the mean differences.

pic_details <- read_csv("../plots/picture_details.csv") |>
  mutate(changepoint = round(cpLoc*t,0)) 

target_summary <- target |> left_join(pic_details,by="lineup_id") |> 
  rowwise() |> 
  mutate(shift=factor(ifelse(time <= changepoint,1,0),levels=c(1,0))) |> 
  ungroup() |> 
  group_by(lineup_id,shift) |> 
  summarize(mean=mean(value),sd=sd(value),n=n()) |> 
  ungroup()

target_summary |> pivot_wider(id_cols="lineup_id",
                              names_from = shift,
                              values_from= c(mean, sd, n)) |> 
  mutate(meanshift=mean_1-mean_0,
         pooled_var = (sd_1^2 * (n_1-1)+sd_0^2 * (n_0-1))/(n_1 + n_0 - 2),
         pooled_sd = sqrt(pooled_var),
         SN_ratio=abs(meanshift/pooled_sd)) |> 
  select(lineup_id, meanshift, pooled_var, pooled_sd, SN_ratio) -> target_summary

#write_csv(target_summary,file="../data/summarystatistics_lineups.csv")
```

### Downloading lineup data

```{r}
responses <- read.csv("../data/lineup_clean.csv") |> select(lineup_id,correct) 

merged <- target_summary |> left_join(responses,by="lineup_id") |> filter(!is.na(correct)) |> 
  mutate(direction=ifelse(meanshift>0,"positive","negative")) |> 
  group_by(lineup_id,SN_ratio,direction) |> 
  summarize(n=n(),n_correct=sum(as.numeric(correct))) |> mutate(prop_correct=n_correct/n)
   
  #mutate(correct=factor(correct,levels=c(0,1)))
```


### Logistic regression analysis

```{r}
mod <- glm(prop_correct~SN_ratio,data=merged, family=binomial(link="logit"))
summary(mod) -> modsummary
summary(mod)
merged$predicted = mod$fitted.values
```

#### Plot

```{r}
merged |> ggplot(aes(x=SN_ratio)) -> plt

plt+ geom_point(aes(y=prop_correct,color=direction)) + geom_line(color="red",aes(y=predicted)) + geom_hline(yintercept=0.5,linetype="dashed", color="blue")
```
Calculate the actual value for a probability of correct identification p.

```{r}
modsummary$coefficients |> as.data.frame() |> select(Estimate) -> coef


SN_p <- function(p,a=coef){
  -a$Estimate[1]/a$Estimate[2] + log(p/(1-p))
}
SN_p(0.5) #50% correct identification

SN_p(0.75) # 75% correct identification

SN_p(0.90) #90% correct identification

```
